name: Old Course (St Andrews links: fescue, whins, North Sea)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2). The Old Course in summer: firm, pale yellow-green fescue fairways and greens, tawny bent-and-fescue rough (F0-F2), dark whins (gorse) in yellow flower, brown-grey links sand with turf-faced bunkers, a cold grey-blue North Sea and the pale West Sands. Course chat's proposal 2026-11-13 (no open orthophoto: colours from the course's character). Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
